name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 28 times in 10 visits over 64 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 56 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-05-30, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.35 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
